name: left_join_nullability
description: A view over a LEFT JOIN must widen the outer side's columns to nullable, exactly as a direct query does -- the previous mini-resolver cloned base-table nullability verbatim and never inspected join kind
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id serial PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE profiles (id serial PRIMARY KEY, user_id integer NOT NULL, bio text NOT NULL)
CREATE VIEW user_bios AS SELECT u.id, u.name, p.bio FROM users u LEFT JOIN profiles p ON u.id = p.user_id
